test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• OWL → Two consonants and a vowel.
 
• LUX → Two consonants and a vowel.
 
• GHE → Two consonants and a vowel.
 
• BJP → Three consonants.

Hence, '**BJP**' is the odd one out.
